mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) and strong housing starts (above 1300 thousand units) signals a robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 AND HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 490,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 490000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index value above 250 signals persistent inflation that leads to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong industrial production (above 105 index) and robust housing starts (above 1300 thousand units) signals a broad-based economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 105 AND HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 250), rising real interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
